title: Sanskrit Sahityar Buranji
author: Harmohan Dev Goswami
genre: Classical Comparative Literature & Intellectual History of Assam
description: Comprehensive critical history of Sanskrit literature and classical learning in Assam by Harmohan Dev Goswami, examining ancient Vedic and classical genres, royal copper-plate inscriptions, philosophical treatises, and the cross-fertilization between Tai-Ahom chroniclers and Sanskrit scholarship in medieval Assam.
